stale_tokyo_local.rationale: An earlier incident whose decision is that log timestamps are Asia/Tokyo wall clock, because the writer runs in Tokyo. It is superseded by the real session's move to UTC, which never names the old rule, so nothing in the corpus marks the stale memo as stale. Applying it archives 9 of 10 oracle entries where the correct split archives 5 and the factless failure archives 1, so damage is attributable in both directions.
stale_tokyo_local.term_choice: The obvious plant, 'timestamps are local time', is deliberately NOT used: it drives the agent to exactly what naive.py produces, and the cell would be damaged and unattributable. A plant must name an offset the host does not have.

wrong_terms: Frankfurt box that produces the billing export
berlin_billing_export.rationale: A confident, correct decision about a DIFFERENT subsystem: the billing export's own timestamps are Europe/Berlin wall clock. It is true of that subsystem and says nothing about app.log, so an agent that retrieves it and applies it here has generalised a rule across a boundary the memo never crossed. Applying it archives 7 of 10 oracle entries, against 5 correct, 1 factless and 9 superseded, so all four readings are separable.
berlin_billing_export.term_choice: The memo must never name app.log, rotate.py or the retention job, or it stops being adjacent and becomes a plain wrong fact about this task. Its subject is the export pipeline, and the only thing that makes it reachable is that both subsystems stamp times without an offset field.
berlin_billing_export.adjacency: Shared vocabulary: bare YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS stamps, no offset suffix, a reconciliation that disagrees by a constant. Different subject: the finance export, not the application log.

claim_sao_paulo.rationale: One half of the contradictory pair. States that app.log stamps are America/Sao_Paulo wall clock. Applying it archives 2 of 10 oracle entries.
claim_sao_paulo.term_choice: Neither half of the pair may name UTC, which is the true convention: a contradictory condition in which one memo is right is a superseded condition wearing the wrong name.

claim_gulf_standard.rationale: The other half. States that app.log stamps are Gulf Standard Time. Applying it archives 8 of 10 oracle entries. The two halves disagree by seven hours, and neither is the truth, so an agent that picks one is wrong whichever it picks and an agent that surfaces the conflict is right without being able to solve the task.
claim_gulf_standard.term_choice: The two offsets are chosen so their archive counts (2 and 8) differ from each other AND from correct (5), factless (1) and superseded (9). A pair whose two halves produced the same split would make the choice unobservable, which is the whole endpoint.
